critical_code_review_comments: bookings.py /public/clinics/{slug}/availability assumes existing bookings' scheduled_at is stored as a string in the same date prefix as queried; this works because public_create_booking stores scheduled_at AS-IS from client (UTC ISO). However FO create_booking also stores client-supplied scheduled_at unchanged — if the FO modal sends local time without TZ suffix, the day-bucket query may put a booking under the wrong UTC day. Recommend normalizing scheduled_at to UTC ISO with offset on insert (both public + FO).

owner_dashboard revenue aggregation uses treatment_items.created_at — if items are created at visit-time but visit is back-dated, MTD revenue will be skewed. Consider using visit_date or a dedicated invoiced_at field.

public_create_booking conflict check matches scheduled_at exactly (string equality) — does NOT detect overlapping different-duration bookings on overlapping but non-identical start times. The availability endpoint correctly computes overlap by minute ranges, so the UI will hide overlapping slots, but a direct API caller could still squeeze in an overlapping POST.
BOOKING_STATUSES validation is enforced server-side on PUT /status (good). No transition-graph enforcement (e.g., completed → booked is allowed); fine for MVP but worth documenting.
